clauses.quote: the Teacher and/or the WTU shall schedule a meeting in the shared grievance scheduler with a representative of DCPS’ Office of Labor Management and Employee Relations (LMER) in an effort to resolve the grievance.
WTU may move the matter to the next step within thirty (30) school days of DCPS’s failure to respond in time.
the parties may mutually agree to submit the grievance to voluntary mediation in accordance with the then current Rules/Guidelines of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service (“FMCS”).
The parties shall establish the timelines for completion of this mediation.
the WTU shall have the right to move to Step 2 of the grievance process, within 10 school days.
the grievance shall advance to Step 2.
clauses.notes: Procedural progression rule; subject is non-human but establishes a mandatory step.

clauses.quote: The Chancellor, or his/her designee, and those he/she may further name, shall meet with the representatives of the WTU, and with the persons referred to in Step 1, on a date mutually agreed upon by DCPS and WTU
clauses.subject_text: The Chancellor, or his/her designee, and those he/she may further name

clauses.quote: the Chancellor or designee shall render a decision, in writing, within ten days of such meeting.
all parties are afforded the opportunity to present evidence, witnesses, and arguments in support of their respective position(s).
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is management/district establishing hearing rights.

clauses.quote: The hearing officers shall submit his/her decision to the parties
the decision is binding absent a request for arbitration by either party.
clauses.notes: Status clause defining finality of hearing decision.
